## What this letter says
Your hernia operation is on Friday 20 November 2026.
The letter tells you to stop your aspirin before then.

## What you need to do
1. Stop taking your aspirin 7 days before your operation. Your last dose is on Thursday 12 November 2026.
2. Take all your other medicines as normal.

## Dates and medicines
- Hernia operation: Friday 20 November 2026.
- Last dose of aspirin: Thursday 12 November 2026.
- Aspirin: stop. The letter does not say the dose or how often.
- All your other medicines: continue as normal.

## Questions to ask your doctor
- What is a hernia?
- Why must I stop aspirin before the operation?
- Is there more I should know?

## When to get urgent help
The letter does not list specific warning signs.

If you are worried and it is not an emergency, call NHS 111. In an emergency, call 999.

---
